Subject: Redwood demo & tech deep-dive — confirm time (Wed 2/28)

Hi Aisha —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap: you and your team want to validate inference latency at 1k QPS, evaluate private deployment options, and confirm retention/audit controls for PHI scope. Ben will join the technical deep-dive.

I penciled in Wed 2/28 at 2:00pm PT for a 45-min technical demo + Q&A. I attached a short agenda and the list of pre-reads we mentioned. I just sent a calendar invite titled "Redwood x LuminaHealth — Technical Deep Dive" from my calendar; please let me know if you didn’t receive the event.

Prep ask: could you share the SLAs you currently have for inference (p99 latency, throughput targets) and any regulatory constraints we should know about? If you prefer, you can drop the doc to the HubSpot deal (link below).

Proposed next steps:
- Confirm you received the invite and can join 2/28 2:00pm PT (45m)
- If not received, I’ll propose two alternate windows in PT and CET
- Ben will follow up with a short checklist for logs/metrics we’ll need access to for the proof-of-concept

Thanks — talk soon.

—
Soojin Lee

- Wed 2/28 11:00am PT / 2:00pm ET (45m)
- Thu 2/29 9:00am PT / 12:00pm ET (45m)

If neither works, we can do a short 30-min slot earlier (8:00am PT / 11:00am ET) but Ben prefers 45 min for the demo. We’ll cover: infra architecture, KV cache behavior, quantization impact, and a quick routing/fallback demo.

Bridge link (temporary): https://meet.redwood.ai/bridge/lumina-8931-temp
I’ve also attached the security questionnaire answers we mentioned — lightweight summary for your compliance team.
